item.title: Jenkins批量控制虚拟机开启与关闭
item.description: brew services start jenkins http://localhost:8080/ ### 终端查看启动的列表 VMRUN='/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Public/vmrun' '$VMRUN' list ### 终端扫描 find /Users -type f -name '*.vmx' 2>/dev/null - ### 终端执行验证是否成功 ### 启动 '/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Public/vmrun' -T fusion start '/Users/chen/Virtual Machines.localized/Ubuntu 64-bit Arm 24.04.3.vmwarevm/Ubuntu 64-bit Arm 24.04.3.vmx' gui ### 列表 '/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Public/vmrun' list ### 停止 '/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Public/vmrun' -T fusion stop '/Users/chen/Virtual Machines.localized/Ubuntu 64-bit Arm 24.04.3.vmwarevm/Ubuntu 64-bit Arm 24.04.3.vmx' soft ### Jenkins下载插件 Active Choices ### groovy代码 ``` def searchDirs = [ new File('/Users/chen/Virtual Machines.localized'), new File('/Users/chen/Documents/Virtual Machines.localized') ] def vmNames = [] searchDirs.each { dir -> if (dir.exists()) { dir.eachFileRecurse(groovy.io.FileType.FILES) { file -> if (file.name.endsWith('.vmx')) { // 去掉 .vmx 后缀，只提取虚拟机名称 def vmName = file.name.replaceAll(/\.vmx$/, '') vmNames.add(vmName) } } } } // 排序并去重 return vmNames.sort().unique() ``` ### shell代码 ``` #!/bin/bash set -e # VMware Fusion vmrun 命令行工具路径 VMRUN='/Applications/VMware Fusion.app/Contents/Library/vmrun' if [ ! -f '$VMRUN' ]; then echo '[ERROR] 未找到 vmrun 工具: $VMRUN' exit 1 fi echo '==========================================' echo '1. 解析选中的虚拟机名称' echo '==========================================' SELECTED_VMS=() if [ -n '$VM_LIST' ]; then IFS=',' read -r -a RAW_SELECTED <<< '$VM_LIST' for name in '${RAW_SELECTED[@]}'; do trimmed=$(echo '$name' | xargs) if [ -n '$trimmed' ]; then SELECTED_VMS+=('$trimmed') echo '-> 目标保持运行: $trimmed' fi done fi if [ ${#SELECTED_VMS[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo '提示: 未勾选任何虚拟机，所有运行中的虚拟机将被关机。

item.title: REDIS配置
item.description:
1. 惰性删除：访问 key 时才检查是否过期，过期则删除
  2. 定期删除：定时抽查一批 key，删掉过期的
  3. 持久化过滤：RDB/AOF 不会保存已过期的 key
  4. 内存淘汰策略：内存满了时，按配置的策略（LRU/LFU/Random 等）主动腾空间

定期 + 惰性 管过期，淘汰策略 管内存上限，持久化 不备份死数据。

item.title: NGINX配置
ubuntu-24.04.4-live-server-arm64-K8s全过程部署
item.description:
### root密码，更新，nano下载，ssh连接 sudo passwd root sudo apt update apt install nano -y sudo nano /etc/ssh/sshd_config PermitRootLogin yes sudo systemctl restart ssh
### 主机名，关闭分区，永久分区，内核配置，时区 sudo hostnamectl set-hostname k8s-master sudo swapoff -a sudo sed -i '/\/swap.img/s/^/#/' /etc/fstab
``` cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/modules-load.d/k8s.conf overlay br_netfilter EOF
sudo modprobe overlay sudo modprobe br_netfilter
cat <<EOF | sudo tee /etc/sysctl.d/k8s.conf net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables = 1 net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables = 1 net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1 EOF
sudo sysctl --system ``` timedatectl set-timezone Asia/Shanghai
### ip地址，ping nano /etc/netplan/50-cloud-init.yaml ``` network: version: 2 ethernets: enp2s0: dhcp4: no addresses: [192.168.114.145/24] gateway4: 192.168.114.2 nameservers: addresses: [8.8.8.8,114.114.114.114] ``` netplan apply
apt update apt install -y inetutils-ping。
